title: AbbVie Director Jennifer Davis Resigns From Board
summary: Jennifer L. Davis resigned from AbbVie's board effective November 2, 2026, after her appointment as CEO of Align Technology, an 8-K filing says.
body_markdown:
Gotrade News - Jennifer L. Davis has resigned from the board of directors of AbbVie Inc. ([ABBV](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/abbv/) ) effective Monday, November 2, 2026, according to[AbbVie's Form 8-K filing](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1551152/000110465926121322/tm2628215d1_8k.htm) with the SEC. The filing says she is leaving in light of her recent appointment as Chief Executive Officer at Align Technology, Inc.

## What AbbVie Announced


On Wednesday, October 28, 2026, Davis, a Class II director of AbbVie, notified the company's Board of Directors of her intent to resign from the board, effective Monday, November 2, 2026, according to the filing. AbbVie reported the departure under Item 5.02 of the Form 8-K, in a filing that came out at 4:05 p.m. ET on Monday.
